note: Take Root is not used: the Kulish text (ukr1871, public domain, 1905) was fetched from the ebible mirror on raw.githubusercontent.com (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/ukr_pan) via scripts/bible_mirror.py — 66 books, 31,082 verses, zero welded sentences — and handed to every translator on disk.

Statuses were checked by measurement, not taken from the translators' reports: a row stays mined only when the rendered block (±1) carries at least two consecutive words of the cited Kulish verse verbatim (blind to our quotation marks and case). Four claimed rows failed that and are self_rendered; two more were demoted on the translator's own flag (1 Thess 2:13, Ps 118:23). Bare sermon-text citations that quote no words carry no row.

Kulish's inner mark ‟ (U+201F) is normalised to “, as in the shipped uk corpus. Hebrews is cited as «Євреїв», not Kulish's running head «Жидів» (the corpus majority, and «жид» is pejorative in modern Ukrainian). Other book names follow Kulish's \toc2 heads (Маттея, Дїяння, Псальма, 1 Мойсея…).
